dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You seem to know a great deal.

dialogues.speaker: Wenze
dialogues.text: Honestly, it's not much. I've loved history since I was little, and I've always wanted to see these ruins in person. That's why I became an adventurer.

dialogues.speaker: Wenze
dialogues.text: Well... these are some records I've made of my adventures. You can have them.

dialogues.speaker: Wenze
dialogues.text: Nothing would make me happier than to help someone else with my knowledge!

dialogues.speaker: Wenze
dialogues.text: Hello, are you also an adventurer searching for the Abandoned City?

dialogues.speaker: Wenze
dialogues.text: Oh, you haven't heard? Somewhere beneath these ruins lies an ancient abandoned city.

dialogues.speaker: Wenze
dialogues.text: Rumors of such a place have circulated for many generations at the Adventurers' Guild, but nobody has found it yet.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's the history of this place?

dialogues.speaker: Wenze
dialogues.text: These ruins were once a city, too. But it was probably abandoned long before even the Archon War.

dialogues.speaker: Wenze
dialogues.text: It is said that beneath those two trees are buried the bodies of the last king of the ancient city and his enemy, who was also his true love...

dialogues.speaker: Wenze
dialogues.text: They perished together, but their burial separates them for eternity.

dialogues.speaker: Wenze
dialogues.text: The two trees that grew above the ruins once everything had turned to dust stand, just like them, face to face but separated...
